Name: Crow Coast Farm
Author: Luminte
Description:
[size=4]The farm has wild crows that will spawn around the farm(They have no effect on crops).[/size]

[size=4]The [b]Starter Gift [/b]gives 1 Coffee Bean and 1 Crow Tamer which is a powerful scarecrow that's recipe is unlocked at level 9 Farming.[/size]

[size=4]You can refill your [b]watering can[/b] in the water buckets close to the farmhouse for easier watering![/size]

[size=4]Includes Map Edits for Vanilla and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Earthy Recolour[/url][/size]

[size=4][b]Config Options[/b]:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]The Crow Statue that replaces the normal warp statue can be reverted[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Crow Spawns can be turned off or on[/size][/*]
[/list][size=4]Endorsements are very appreciated![/size]

Manifest.Name: Crow Coast Farm
Manifest.Description: A new farm with a coast, crows, and plenty of room for crops.
Manifest.Author: Luminte
